response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT COALESCE(CENTROMEA, 'missing') AS status, GOT - GPT AS ast_alt, APTT - PT AS aptt_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), per_status AS (SELECT status, AVG(ast_alt) AS avg_ast_alt, AVG(aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_pt FROM filtered GROUP BY status) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status;
